owned.fidbf.description: Genuine raw Ghidra paged database written by DBHandle.saveAs, not renamed JSON
owned.fidbf.hashes: Explicitly seeded test records, not claimed hashes of decoded machine instructions
owned.fidbf.source_paths: Untrusted synthetic metadata only; never opened

owned.export.description: Bounded private RPFID001 bridge transport exported from owned.fidbf; NOT a fidbf

cases: raw magic mismatch and renamed JSON
out-of-range and invalid negative free-block pointers
allocated physical block with an unknown prefix flag
dangling library reference in a valid database
negative_fixtures.storage: Generated privately and deleted by the test

native_program_workflow.linker: ld.lld --build-id=none -e _start; heldout uses -DHOLDOUT and ld.lld -s; negative additionally uses -DNEGATIVE
native_program_workflow.host: Explicit installed Ghidra 12.1.4 PUBLIC and host JVM; source-file static analysis only

analysis_controls.launcher: Direct explicit trusted JVM with ghidra.Ghidra/AnalyzeHeadless, -noanalysis, -loader ElfLoader, -loader-loadLibraries false, -loader-linkExistingProjectLibraries false, fresh private project and absolute owned script path
analysis_controls.failure_boundary: -noanalysis prevents default and post-script automatic analysis even if the fixed exporter fails to compile; no reliance on a potentially failing pre-script
analysis_controls.all_other_analyzers_disabled: Including DWARF, external symbol resolver, Function ID auto-annotation, demanglers and data archive importers; only the fixed script starts TimeoutTaskMonitor-bounded analysis after setting and checking the allowlist
analysis_controls.input_admission: Standalone static x86/x86-64 executable ELF; no interpreter, needed libraries, build ID, recognized debug locators (.debug/.zdebug/.gnu_debug/.stab/.note/.gdb/.dwo/.btf/.ctf); unsupported inputs are never stripped or modified

native_program_workflow.database_training: Reference producer names only; actual FidService hashes and actual static call-reference relations
native_program_workflow.target_features: RPFPG001 includes exact imported-binary SHA-256, profile, addresses, body ranges, real hash quads and call addresses; no target names
native_program_workflow.positive: 2 genuine FID function records match the independently analyzed stripped held-out ELF after a layout shift
native_program_workflow.negative: 0 records match the stripped variant changing an included small rotate scalar and the mix scalar
native_program_workflow.observed_limitation: Changing only a large composite-operand scalar left the leaf full/specific hashes unchanged in actual Ghidra; this implementation preserves that algorithm, so FID suggestions are not semantic identity or automatic annotation authority
native_program_workflow.native_extents_source: Independent Rampage MCP list_functions on native-heldout.elf before Ghidra target feature export; production API recomputes native discovery, never seeds it from these ranges
native_program_workflow.verification: FidNativeFixtureTest.java: actual raw database/schema and exact SHA-bound held-out feature quads; checks mandatory real callee relation

executed_host_configuration.temporary_root: Explicit operator-provided private staging root; never inferred from input metadata
executed_host_configuration.authentication_limitation: These hashes record the executed local public tool configuration, not upstream publisher authentication or a sandbox guarantee

hash_oracle.implementation: Actual Ghidra MessageDigestFidHasher with synthetic semantic-feature proxies
hash_oracle.limitation: Validates digest/mixing only, not any native instruction decoder or architecture adapter
